Page 51 Cont.
Mar. 11 Walter Wilski - 7- in St. Veronica's T.B. Spinal Maningitis - ac- cording to Drs ... hopeless. Enrolled To-night in Ser. Mass Ass'n Father 5 months away from Holy Com. Mother promises to be in- structed, etc, etc. He ... to go more frequently to Holy Communion - and promises also perpetual Enrollment.
12 Reported improving - parents both here.
Florence Millar - 33 - peculiar case ostamalitis - Drs. want to amputate arm .... Very threatening
Mrs. Helen Lowery - 65 - very threatening in-cancer - beautifully resigned prepared etc but family and friends anxious ..... Enrolled perpetually to-nite 2nd time.
Henry Kubitski - 21 - has spells etc ...
Baby Jean Mary Cools - 6 weeks - birth-marks. ... . .
Page 52 Mar. 16 18 Marie Pastorino - 48 - of 1621 Parkview - Detroit, M. on way to Florida for health improvement, met serious trolley accident(Accident March 6) Spinal fraction - taken in stretcher to Hospital. Her sis- ter came to monastery - evening and enrolled her in Ser. Mass As. Next morning after enrollment ... (promising perpetually) ... Drs. and nurses - all were astonished ... patient sat up - walked - is to con- tinue trip south next week. Some of them refuse to believe cure.
Anthony Malcoun - 5 - infantile parlysis and spinal-maningitis - early last August - Enrolled by phone and prayers asked; is here To-day mentally alert but can not stand Except like on tip-toes ....
John Teahen - 17 - auto accident on 17th September last, badly broken leg - has been operated on yesterday for 3rd time. Drs. in Harper Hosp. think he will have to be in cast for at least a year. He is enrolled To-day - requested by Mrs. Schleuss - Episcopelian neighbor. 25th Drs. suprised now they hope. Sept. 2 - 1944 3rd cast removed Aug. 28 - last Monday leg is saved .... Father offers $20. for PP. Souls.
Mrs. Mary Reynolds - 35 - T.B. in Kiefer's 12 yrs. Wants to get well and have Fam.
Mrs. Dorothy DeGuvera - 28 - very nerveous ... fears .... boy now 2 weeks old ....
